hints.title: Days Since Base Epoch
hints.text: Convert each date string into the total number of days elapsed since a fixed epoch date like 1971-01-01.

hints.title: Leap Year Handling
hints.text: A year is a leap year if divisible by 4 and not divisible by 100, or divisible by 400.

hints.title: Absolute Difference
hints.text: Compute days_from_epoch(date1) and days_from_epoch(date2). Return abs(d1 - d2).

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Ignoring leap year rules (century years divisible by 100 but not 400) gives off-by-one errors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting days from a fixed anchor year runs in constant iterations and memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles leap years (including 2000 vs 1900 rules) and month day arrays accurately.
